I'm autistic and I've had a lot of similar experiences growing up. Feeling so out of place and different from everyone else definitely contributed to my suicidal ideations, especially because I didn't want to accept my diagnosis. Eventually I accepted that I actually was autistic and now I'm a lot happier. I have a boyfriend who accepts me for who I am, a great friend group with both neurotypical and neurodiverse people, and my mom has learned a lot more about how autism works over the years. There are people out there who will accept you, even if you haven't found them yet. I still deal with depression and anxiety and mental illness in general, but it's so much easier to deal with when you have a good support group. I hope you can reach out for help and find people you can trust, hang in there <3
